value: EQC-T1 Worker Return Equivalence Claim Evidence Linter is CLOSED_PASS_BOUNDED at material commit ccee892d (dispatch/material base a63de6d3), resolving the ASSF-T4 MACHINE_CHECK_CANDIDATE escalation by adding governance/compat/check_equivalence_claim_evidence.py (one additive REVIEWER_FAST_CHECKS entry) plus focused tests; reviewer independently re-derived every worker claim (24/24 tests, 0 self-check violations on the committed range, and an independent 916/1615/86/129 full-corpus dry-run reproduction matching the worker's 915/1615/86/129 within one file) and repaired two dispatcher-authored work-order manifest-cell defects plus one worker-return corpus-completeness field-label defect before closing. The 129 pre-existing flagged violations across 86 files predate EQC-T1 and are not retroactively annotated; retroactive annotation remains a strategic operator decision. ASSF-T4 External And Legacy Intake Normalization contract remains CLOSED_PASS_BOUNDED at closure material commit 40b904bc (dispatch 5a4f9591), with post-review hardening at material commit 1c89d540. Next allowed move is operator selection between: (a) ASSF-T5 Composition, Dependency, Conflict, And Capability Controls, which must consume the ASSF-T1 package contract and the ASSF-T2 generated index/resolver foundation rather than re-deriving schema, with any future normalizer citing docs/reference/agent_system_skills/CVF_ASSF_INTAKE_NORMALIZATION_CONTRACT.md and resolving security_notes/sourceRevision against ASSF-T1 first, and any future promoter citing docs/reference/agent_system_skills/CVF_ASSF_PROMOTION_BRIDGE_CONTRACT.md; or (b) EQC-T2, an explicitly deferred follow-up that would widen the equivalence-claim checker's scanned-file set or add table-row-context exclusion for the 'unchanged' false-positive-adjacent pattern found in structured metadata rows during the EQC-T1 dry run. EQC-T2 was evaluated and declined for low expected value (the 129 dry-run flags across 86 files are review-noise only; adversarial sampling found zero cases where the gap let a real unverified-equivalence claim through; a correct fix risks new false negatives or an LLM-judge, both forbidden by the no-bottleneck constraint), so it must not be re-proposed unless one of two reopen conditions is met and cited: (i) a reviewer reports actually missing a real equivalence-claim defect because it was buried in the noise, citing the specific worker-return/completion-review where this happened, or (ii) the same unchanged-in-metadata-row false-positive pattern is found occurring in docs/baselines/*.md or another governed surface outside the checker's current scanned set. Neither ASSF-T5 nor EQC-T2 may be opened without a fresh GC-018 and source-verified work order. No normalizer code, promoter code, package instance, SKILL.md, skill.source.json, real candidate entry, skill migration, external CLI/MCP adapter implementation, runtime/provider/live/public work, secrets/quota, readiness, automatic promotion, activation, or universal-control claim is released by T4 or EQC-T1.
